text.tspan: SCRIPT — checkpoint: prepare
New task branch and worktree from fetched origin/main
Retries reuse their existing branch / worktree
Shared Git operations are serialized; main checkout untouched
WORKER MODEL — checkpoint: implement
Implement one task; run checks; leave edits uncommitted
Separate supervised pi process in the task worktree
No git handling assigned to the model
SCRIPT — durable worker receipt
After disconnect: adopt live worker or consume its finished result
Interrupted attempts retain partial files for retry
Worker completed
without errors?
SCRIPT — checkpoint: commit
Require changes; git add / commit with task trailer
Recover an already-created commit after a crash
Do not re-run a successfully completed worker
SCRIPT — checkpoint: publish
Push branch; find existing PR or create one
Verify publication; save commit SHA and PR URL
Retry publication without duplicate implementation or PR
SCRIPT — checkpoint: complete
Mark task done only after publication is confirmed
Remove worktree only if safe; never force-delete edits
Return to scheduler
Task done is distinct from PR merged
Dependent tasks still require scripted merge verification
STOP / FAILURE
Persist stage and error; keep worktree and files
/deeep go resumes / retries the saved stage
No unconditional branch reset or destructive cleanup
